info.title: BrewMark API
info.summary: Grind settings across coffee grinders, on one shared scale.
info.description:
The lookup half of the BrewMark Protocol (https://github.com/jeffreygluck/brewmark-protocol): translate a BrewMark Grind Index (BGI) target or an Open Brew Profile to a setting on a named grinder, convert a setting between grinders, read the grinder catalogue, publish profiles under a short code for a coffee bag, and record how first cups tasted. Every lookup works without a key and is CORS-open. Grinder data is commission-free: no prices or retailer links.

A published profile's short link, https://brewmark.io/p/{code}, answers with the profile JSON when asked with Accept: application/json, and with a page otherwise.

post.summary: Submit a particle-size reading for a grinder at one setting
post.description: D10/D50/D90 in µm, volume-weighted, with the method used. For the image method (protocol/measurement.md, the tool at https://brewmark.io/tools/measure-grind) at least 200 particles must have been counted. Numbers only: no photo is accepted. Every reading is stored as pending and counts towards nothing until reviewed. A key is optional; readings sent with one are marked as that key's. Without a key, 20 readings an hour per address.

post.description: Files a request for a key. A person reviews every request; if it is approved, the key is emailed to the address given. The key is never returned by the API. One address may have at most 2 requests waiting and 3 live keys.
